summary: Sketch dimensions on the canvas are now selected before they are edited. Hovering a dimension's value, line or arrows highlights the points, lines, arcs and circles it measures; hovering a row in the relations or constraint issues list highlights the same geometry, including the origin or axis that a coordinate is measured from. A click selects one dimension and replaces the geometry selection, Shift toggles, Escape clears, and the status line names the selection. Double-click or Enter opens the existing editor; Space selects. Opening the editor, also from Edit value…, keeps the dimension selected and leaves the geometry unselected, so Delete removes the dimension, never the geometry it measures, while the editor is open and after Apply or Cancel. Delete or Backspace removes the selected dimensions in one undo step through the same prepared edit as the relations list, and a refused removal keeps them with its message. A right-click menu offers Edit value…, Make reference or Make driving, and Delete; commands that do not apply stay visible, disabled, with the reason. Dimensions draw thinner: no label box, 1 px lines, slimmer arrows, quieter extension lines and haloed monospace values in theme colours, with reference values in parentheses and a dimmer colour. A selection, keyboard focus and an open menu belong to the dimension they were made on: a new value, Make reference and Make driving keep it selected, and so does a Trim or Extend that moves an end of a referenced line; a dimension that undo, redo or an agent edit removes, or replaces with another measurement under the same ID, comes back unselected and without focus, a closing menu or editor does not return focus to the replacement, and a menu closes without running a command when the sketch changes or the edit is cancelled. The size chips on older and plugin profiles draw as plain haloed values like the canvas dimensions, through a new shared annotation button appearance, and follow the same rules: a click selects and highlights the leader, double-click or Enter edits and selects the chip it edits, Delete removes a driving dimension, and the menu offers Edit value…, a disabled Make reference with its reason, and Delete. Accessible names change: canvas dimensions read Dimension or Reference dimension, the quantity and value, then press Enter to edit, instead of Configure or Inspect reference; profile chips read Dimension, the quantity and value, then press Enter to edit, instead of Edit and the quantity.
warning: Potentially breaking for automation and people that click a dimension expecting its editor: a click now only selects, and a double-click or Enter opens the editor. Automation that finds a canvas dimension by its accessible name must use the new names, for example Dimension distance 15 mm, press Enter to edit instead of Configure distance 15 mm, and Reference dimension diameter 6 mm, press Enter to edit instead of Inspect reference diameter 6 mm. Profile size chips change from Edit Width to Dimension width 30 mm, press Enter to edit. Delete with a dimension selected removes the dimension, not geometry. While the editor of a canvas dimension is open, cad_get_viewport.selectedSketchGeometrySet is empty: opening the editor by double-click, Enter or Edit value… keeps the dimension selected instead of selecting the geometry it measures, so automation that read the edited geometry from the viewport selection must read the relation from the document instead. No breaking change for installed posts, machine packages, saved revisions, CAD documents or controller output.

checklist.schema: No CAD schema change: removals use the existing remove-sketch-relation and remove-sketch-dimension edits, and conversions use set-sketch-relation with the existing reference-dimension, distance and radial-size kinds. No UPID, post, machine package, execution plan, saved revision, storage, journal, worker reply or native buffer protocol change; the Rust solver and committed WebAssembly module are unchanged. Post engine API remains 1 and saved-job engine remains 3.
checklist.events: No execution event or input-version behavior change. Hover runs no solver or analysis call and renders only the highlight overlay; moving the pointer across a dimension label, line or arrow, or across relation and issue rows, does not render the sketch canvas. Canvas and chip menus close, and their commands are dropped, when the part, version, build or sketch changed, the edit was cancelled, or the dimension was replaced after the menu opened. Selections keep the dimension identity they were made on, so a reused relation or constraint ID never inherits one. Keyboard focus is bound to the same identity: a replacement under the same ID mounts a new label or chip, so neither focus nor a closing menu or editor returns to it, and Delete, Backspace and menu commands check the identity before they run. A line-length reference is identified by its line, so a Trim or Extend that rewrites an endpoint keeps it selected. WebMCP tools and their arguments are unchanged, and dimension selection is not part of the agent viewport state. One viewport value changes: cad_get_viewport.selectedSketchGeometrySet is empty while a canvas dimension editor is open, where it used to hold the measured geometry; docs/site/agents.md says so.
checklist.capabilities: No post or machine capability change. Canvas dimensions and profile chips gain selection, hover highlight, Delete and a context menu; double-click or Enter opens the editor that a click opened before. Opening that editor no longer selects the measured geometry: the editor works on it while the dimension stays selected. The shared Button gains an annotation variant and theme.css gains the --annotation-halo token; existing variants are unchanged.
checklist.auditAndOutput: No generation, audit, numbering, encoding, line ending, feed or controller-file change.
checklist.installationAndStorage: No installed package, revision, browser-cache or folder storage change. Saved documents open unchanged and older releases open documents edited with this one.
checklist.verification: Full Vitest passed: 551 files, 6236 tests. cadSketchDimensionSelection unit tests cover selection, the dimension identity rules (value edits, Make reference and Make driving keep a pick; a reused ID that measures something else drops it; a line reference keeps its pick when Trim or Extend rewrites an endpoint and through a later Make driving), refreshed picks, mount keys that change only on replacement, reconciliation, status text, highlight targets and the hover store; CadSketchGraphDimensions, CadSketchCanvasRender, CadSketchDimensionControls, CadGearInteraction and CadWorkbench tests cover click selection, Shift toggles, Space, Escape, Enter and double-click editing, hover highlights from labels and relation rows, one-step Delete, refused removal messages, the context menu with disabled reasons, menus that close on a replaced dimension, a part change or Cancel, selections that never pass to a reused ID, that pointer moves across labels, dimension lines, arrows, relation rows and issue rows render only the overlay, that Enter, double-click and Edit value… keep the dimension selected with no geometry selected so Delete removes only the dimension before and after Apply and Cancel, and that focus, a closing menu or editor, and a right-press never pass to a replacement label or chip. Each round 2 test fails with its fix reverted. npm run build, npm run lint, npm run ui:check and node scripts/check-release.mjs origin/main pass. Chromium specs with two workers: cad-sketch-dimension-selection 1/1, cad-sketch-constraints 27/27, cad-sketch-reference-dimensions 1/1 and cad-workflow 32/32. No controller or machine verification applies because output is unchanged.

publicNotes.summary: Sketch dimensions select on click and edit on double-click.
changes: Hover a dimension, or a row in the relations list, to highlight the geometry it measures, including the origin or axis for a coordinate.
Click a dimension to select it, Shift-click to add or remove one and Escape to clear. Double-click or press Enter to edit it.
Opening a dimension's editor keeps the dimension selected, so Delete removes the dimension and never the geometry it measures.
Delete or Backspace removes the selected dimensions in one undo step. Right-click a dimension for Edit value…, Make reference or Make driving, and Delete; unavailable commands explain why.
Dimensions draw with thin lines and plain values; reference values show in parentheses in a dimmer colour.
The size chips on older and plugin profiles draw as plain values like the canvas dimensions and follow the same click, double-click, Delete and right-click rules.

A selection, keyboard focus or open menu stays with its dimension: a dimension replaced by an edit or brought back by undo starts unselected and without focus, a menu closes when the sketch changes, and a reference to a line's length stays selected through Trim and Extend.
publicNotes.compatibility: Sketches keep using existing relation and dimension kinds, so earlier releases open them. Installed machine packages, posts, saved revisions and controller output are unchanged.
publicNotes.action: Double-click a dimension, or press Enter on it, where a single click used to open its editor. Automation that finds dimensions by accessible name should use the new names, such as Dimension distance 15 mm, press Enter to edit. While a dimension editor is open, the agent viewport now reports no selected geometry.
